summary.intent: Fix a broken statusline and Stop-hook error, update GSD to 1.6.0, clean up stale git worktrees, and start planning phase 61 (AAD-Bound Seal Primitive and Cross-Language KAT).
summary.outcome: Statusline fixed by renaming hook to .cjs; GSD reinstalled to 1.6.0 fixing the missing gsd-context-monitor.js Stop-hook error; three worktrees removed cleanly; phase 61 research completed with HIGH confidence and committed.

repo: package.json has "type": "module" — all .js files are treated as ESM by Node; hooks written in CommonJS must use .cjs extension to override this.
GSD hooks are gitignored (.gitignore:55, pattern .claude/hooks/gsd-*) — they are regenerated per-clone via npx @opengsd/gsd-core, not tracked in git.
.gitignore comment pins the canonical GSD version (1.6.0); worktree installs were on 1.4.3.
Phase 61 test files must live at packages/crypto/src/__tests__/ (not packages/crypto/__tests__/) — vitest include: ['src/**/*.ts'] won't discover the latter path.
scripts/check-vector-parity.sh has a hardcoded EXPECTED_VECTORS array; adding node-aad.json to it is a required CI integration task or the parity check step fails.
sealAesGcmAad mints a fresh random IV on every call — fixed-IV KAT vectors must target the lower-level encryptAesGcmAad/decrypt_aes_gcm_aad instead.
uuid crate (v1.23.4) is not yet in Cargo.toml workspace or crates/crypto/Cargo.toml — Phase 61 must add it.
Zero AAD consumers exist today across both packages — Phase 61 is purely additive with no risk of breaking existing callsites.

code.finding: Hardcoded EXPECTED_VECTORS array must be extended with tests/vectors/crypto/node-aad.json or the CI parity step fails even when both Rust and TS tests pass.
Canonical location for crypto TS tests per vitest include glob; CONTEXT.md had the wrong path (packages/crypto/__tests__/).
Renamed to statusline.cjs to force CommonJS interpretation. The .js extension was causing MODULE_NOT_FOUND-style crash under package.json "type": "module".

workflow: Renaming a CommonJS hook from .js to .cjs forces Node to treat it as CJS regardless of the project-wide "type": "module" setting — smallest fix for ESM/CJS conflicts in hooks.

When the GSD main-tree install is a broken fragment (missing gsd-tools.cjs, manifest, most workflows), /gsd-update cannot self-heal; the correct fix is a clean reinstall via npx @opengsd/gsd-core@<version> -- gsd-core --claude --local.
git worktree remove detaches the working directory but leaves the branch intact; branches must be deleted separately if cleanup is desired.
The commit helper has a known false-negative — always verify commits landed via git log rather than trusting the helper's success/failure signal.
GSD installer prompts interactively on stale fragment files (keep/remove); pass resolution flags or re-run non-interactively to avoid blocking.

friction: GSD main-tree install was a broken fragment — missing gsd-tools.cjs, gsd-file-manifest.json, gsd-context-monitor.js, and most workflows — so the normal /gsd-update flow couldn't run at all.
Stop hook error (MODULE_NOT_FOUND for gsd-context-monitor.js) fired on every turn, spamming errors even though it was harmless to task execution.
GSD installer ran interactively and paused on stale fragment files, requiring a second non-interactive invocation.
CONTEXT.md for phase 61 contained an incorrect test path (packages/crypto/__tests__/) that would have caused the planner to generate unreachable test files without the researcher's catch.
Codebase drift map was stale (non-blocking per directive: warn, but noted as signal of staleness).
open_items: Branches fix/phase60-safety-tail and fix/fuse-delete-share-revocation still exist after worktree removal — user may want to delete them.
Plan-phase 61 pipeline is mid-flight: pattern-mapper → planner (Opus) → plan-checker (Sonnet) still to run; VALIDATION.md body not yet populated.

Three open questions from research deferred to planner: (1) one node-aad.json file with two keyed arrays vs two files, (2) hand-freeze vectors vs extending generate-test-vectors.ts, (3) CryptoError variant names for AAD validation.
GSD worktrees that were removed were on version 1.4.3 — any in-progress work staged there is now gone (confirmed clean before removal, but branches remain if recovery needed).
Statusline fix (statusline.cjs rename + settings.json update) is a tracked change not yet pushed — needs to be included in next commit/PR.
